description: This PHP class 'LDAPDao' provides data access methods for LDAP-related operations within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving users, employees, and LDAP sync status.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: Data access object for LDAP operations, extending BaseDao, handling user and employee LDAP data retrieval and LDAP sync status management.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers associated with multiple users (more than one user per employee).

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a non-local user by username, primarily for LDAP authentication, where the user has no local password set.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username, excluding deleted users.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Gets LDAP authentication provider details by a unique user ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Fetches an employee based on various LDAP search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns all LDAP authentication providers linked to active users.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent LDAP sync status record.
